description: RYDAPT is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adult patients with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) that is FLT3 mutation- positive as detected by an FDA-approved test, in combination with standard cytarabine and daunorubicin induction and cytarabine consolidation. RYDAPT is not indicated as a single-agent induction therapy for the treatment of patients with AML.
